title: Worker's pre-store ownership check treats its own 5s timeout as an interruption, so an outage where connects hang cancels the job instead of waiting
notes: In upload(), the check runs under context.WithTimeout(ctx, lease/2). If Postgres is away in the form where connections hang (packets dropped, as can happen behind a Service during a switchover) rather than being refused or reset, the error is context.DeadlineExceeded. db.IsAway deliberately returns false for that, so the code takes the errInterrupted path: the job is cancelled and its ffmpeg stopp
